title: Items arriving with incorrect sizing compared to description
situation: Customers are receiving items that do not match the listed measurements, risking widespread dissatisfaction and returns if the catalog is not corrected immediately.
hypothesis: Incorrect size guide or manufacturing sizing defect

params.reply_en: We are sorry the size did not fit as expected. We have issued a free replacement shipment for the correct size.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر لأن المقاس لم يكن مناسباً بالشكل المتوقع. لقد قمنا بإنشاء شحنة بديلة مجانية بالمقاس الصحيح.
